title: Burst Balloons Coin Max - Solution
intuition: Burst balloons to maximize collected coins. If you burst balloon i, you get nums[i-1]*nums[i]*nums[i+1] coins.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: Use interval DP. State dp[i][j] holds max coins bursting balloons between i and j. Decide which balloon k bursts last in interval [i, j].
